name: Noah
clues: I built something very large out of wood.
Animals came to me in pairs.
It rained for 40 days and 40 nights.
I sent out a dove to find dry land.
God placed a rainbow in the sky as a promise to me.

name: Moses
clues: I was hidden in a basket as a baby.
I grew up in a palace, though I was not royalty by birth.
God spoke to me through a burning bush.
I led a great number of people on a long journey.
I received stone tablets on a mountaintop.

name: David
clues: I was the youngest of many brothers.
I was a shepherd before I became famous.
I defeated a giant with an unusual weapon.
I played the harp to soothe a troubled king.
I became king of Israel and wrote many songs of praise.

name: Jonah
clues: God asked me to go somewhere, but I ran away.
I boarded a ship heading in the opposite direction.
A great storm arose because of my disobedience.
I was swallowed by a great sea creature.
I spent three days inside a fish before being released.

name: Daniel
clues: I was taken to a foreign land as a young man.
I refused to eat the king's food.
I could understand the meaning of dreams.
My friends survived a fiery furnace.
I was thrown into a den of hungry lions but was unharmed.

name: Adam
clues: I was the very first of my kind.
I was made from the dust of the ground.
I lived in a perfect garden.
I named all the animals.
My wife was made from one of my ribs.

name: Jesus
clues: Angels announced my birth.
I was born in a humble place where animals were kept.
Wise men traveled from far away to see me.
I turned water into wine at a wedding.
I am the Son of God.

name: Mary
clues: An angel appeared to me with an incredible message.
I was engaged but not yet married when I received the news.
I visited my cousin Elizabeth who was also expecting.
I gave birth in a place far from my home.
I am the mother of Jesus.

name: John the Baptist
clues: I lived in the wilderness.
I wore clothing made of camel hair.
I ate locusts and wild honey.
I baptized people in the Jordan River.
I prepared the way for the Messiah.

name: Goliath
clues: I was extremely tall — over nine feet.
I was a warrior from the land of the Philistines.
I challenged an entire army, and no one would face me.
I wore heavy bronze armor.
I was defeated by a shepherd boy with a sling and a stone.

name: Eve
clues: I was the first woman ever created.
I was made while someone else was sleeping.
I lived in a beautiful garden.
A serpent spoke to me and deceived me.
I ate fruit from the one tree that was forbidden.

name: Joshua
clues: I was an assistant to a great leader for many years.
I was one of twelve spies sent to explore a new land.
Only I and one other spy gave a good report.
I led the people across the Jordan River on dry ground.
I marched around the walls of Jericho until they fell.

name: Samuel
clues: My mother prayed earnestly for me before I was born.
I was dedicated to serve God at the tabernacle as a child.
I heard God calling my name at night.
I anointed the first two kings of Israel.
I was the last of the judges.

name: Sarah
clues: I traveled with my husband to a land I had never seen.
For many years I could not have children.
I laughed when I overheard an incredible promise.
I gave birth to a son when I was very old.
My son Isaac was the child God promised to Abraham.

name: Lazarus
clues: I lived in the village of Bethany.
My sisters were Martha and Mary.
I became very sick and died.
My friend Jesus wept when he came to see me.
Jesus called me out of the tomb after four days.

name: Saul
clues: I was from the tribe of Benjamin.
I was taller than anyone else in Israel.
I was chosen as the very first king of Israel.
I grew jealous of a young shepherd who the people loved.
I consulted a medium at Endor before my final battle.

name: Joseph
clues: My father gave me a special colorful garment.
My brothers were very jealous of me.
I was sold and taken to a foreign country.
I could interpret dreams.
I became a powerful ruler in Egypt, second only to Pharaoh.

name: Samson
clues: An angel announced my birth to my parents.
I was set apart for God from before I was born.
My strength was legendary and came from an unusual source.
I was betrayed by someone I loved.
My hair was the secret to my great power.

name: Ruth
clues: I was not originally from Israel.
I chose to stay with my mother-in-law after tragedy struck.
I said, "Where you go, I will go."
I gathered leftover grain in a field.
I became the great-grandmother of King David.

name: Elijah
clues: I was a prophet who challenged false worship.
I was fed by ravens during a drought.
I challenged 450 prophets of Baal on a mountain.
Fire came down from heaven at my prayer.
I was taken to heaven in a chariot of fire.

name: Esther
clues: I was an orphan raised by my cousin.
I was chosen for my beauty.
I became queen of a great empire.
I risked my life by approaching the king uninvited.
I saved my people from a plot to destroy them.

name: Peter
clues: I was a fisherman before I was called.
I walked on water, but then began to sink.
I denied knowing my master three times.
I was the first to preach after receiving the Holy Spirit.
Jesus called me the "rock" upon which he would build his church.

name: Abraham
clues: God told me to leave my home and go to a new land.
God promised to make a great nation from my descendants.
My wife and I had a child in our very old age.
God tested my faith by asking for a great sacrifice.
I am called the father of many nations.

name: Jacob
clues: I was born holding my twin brother's heel.
I tricked my father into giving me a blessing.
I fled from home and dreamed of a ladder reaching heaven.
I worked 14 years to marry the woman I loved.
God changed my name to Israel.

name: Zacchaeus
clues: I was very wealthy but not well liked.
I collected money from people for the government.
I was too short to see over the crowd.
I climbed a sycamore tree to get a better view.
Jesus said he would eat at my house, and I gave half my goods to the poor.

name: Hannah
clues: I was deeply sorrowful because I had no children.
I prayed so fervently that a priest thought I was drunk.
I made a vow to dedicate my child to God.
God answered my prayer and I had a son.
I brought my son Samuel to live at the tabernacle.

name: Naomi
clues: I moved to a foreign land during a famine with my family.
My husband and both my sons died in that land.
I told my daughters-in-law to return to their own families.
One daughter-in-law refused to leave me.
I returned to Bethlehem with Ruth by my side.

name: Martha
clues: I lived in Bethany with my siblings.
I was busy preparing a meal when an important guest arrived.
I complained that my sister was not helping me.
Jesus told me I was worried about many things.
My brother Lazarus was raised from the dead by Jesus.

name: Barnabas
clues: My name means "Son of Encouragement."
I sold a field and gave the money to the apostles.
I vouched for a former persecutor of the church.
I traveled with Paul on his first missionary journey.
I had a disagreement with Paul over giving John Mark a second chance.

name: Miriam
clues: I watched over my baby brother from the riverbank.
I suggested our mother as a nurse to a princess.
I led the women in song and dance after a great victory.
I played a tambourine at the Red Sea.
I was the sister of Moses and Aaron.

name: Timothy
clues: My mother Eunice and grandmother Lois taught me the Scriptures.
I was young when I began my ministry.
A great apostle became like a father to me.
Paul wrote two letters in the Bible addressed to me.
I was told, "Let no one despise your youth."

name: Philip
clues: I was one of the seven chosen to serve the early church.
I preached the gospel in Samaria with great results.
An angel sent me to a desert road.
I met a man from Ethiopia reading the book of Isaiah.
I baptized the Ethiopian official and was then carried away by the Spirit.

name: Rahab
clues: I lived in a walled city.
I helped two strangers who came to my city.
I hid people on my rooftop.
A scarlet cord saved my family.
I was from Jericho and am in the lineage of Jesus.

name: Gideon
clues: An angel found me hiding while threshing wheat.
I asked God for signs involving a fleece.
God told me my army was too large.
My army was reduced from 32,000 to just 300.
We defeated the enemy with trumpets, jars, and torches.

name: Nehemiah
clues: I served as cupbearer to a foreign king.
I wept when I heard about the state of my homeland.
The king granted me permission to return and rebuild.
I organized people to rebuild a wall.
The wall was completed in just 52 days despite opposition.

name: Paul
clues: I was a Roman citizen from birth.
I once persecuted followers of Jesus.
I was blinded by a bright light on a road.
I went on several long missionary journeys.
I wrote many letters that became part of the New Testament.

name: Solomon
clues: I was the son of a king.
God offered me anything I wanted, and I chose wisely.
I built a magnificent temple.
Two women came to me with a dispute over a baby.
I am known as the wisest man who ever lived.

name: Deborah
clues: I held court under a palm tree.
I was both a prophetess and a leader.
I summoned a commander named Barak.
I told Barak that a woman would get credit for the victory.
I judged Israel and led them to victory against Sisera.

name: Elisha
clues: I was plowing a field when I was called.
I received a double portion of my mentor's spirit.
I purified a poisonous pot of stew.
I told a foreign commander to wash in the Jordan River.
I was the successor to a prophet taken up in a chariot of fire.

name: Job
clues: I was the wealthiest man in the East.
God allowed Satan to test me.
I lost my children, livestock, and health in a single day.
Three friends came to comfort me but accused me of sin.
God restored double what I had lost after I remained faithful.

name: Nicodemus
clues: I was a Pharisee and a ruler of the Jews.
I came to see Jesus secretly at night.
Jesus told me I must be "born again."
I asked, "How can a man be born when he is old?"
I helped prepare Jesus' body for burial with expensive spices.

name: Hagar
clues: I was a servant from Egypt.
My mistress gave me to her husband.
I fled into the wilderness when I was mistreated.
An angel found me by a spring of water.
I gave birth to Ishmael, Abraham's first son.

name: Josiah
clues: I became king when I was only eight years old.
I ordered repairs to the temple.
A lost scroll of the Law was found during the repairs.
I tore my robes when I heard the words of the scroll.
I led the greatest religious reform in Judah's history.

name: Balaam
clues: I was a prophet hired by a king to curse Israel.
An angel blocked my path but I could not see him.
My donkey saw the angel before I did.
My donkey spoke to me with a human voice.
Every time I tried to curse Israel, blessings came out instead.

name: Mordecai
clues: I raised my orphaned cousin as my own daughter.
I sat at the king's gate in Susa.
I uncovered a plot to assassinate the king.
I refused to bow to a powerful official named Haman.
I was honored by the king and became second in the kingdom.

name: Jeremiah
clues: God called me to be a prophet while I was still young.
I told God I did not know how to speak.
I wept over my nation's coming destruction.
I was thrown into a muddy cistern for speaking the truth.
I am known as the "weeping prophet."

name: Jezebel
clues: I was a foreign princess who married a king of Israel.
I promoted the worship of Baal throughout the land.
I threatened to kill a great prophet after his victory.
I plotted to steal a vineyard by having its owner killed.
My husband was King Ahab, and my end was foretold by Elijah.

name: Ezekiel
clues: I was a priest who became a prophet in exile.
I lived among the captives by the river Chebar in Babylon.
I had a vision of dry bones coming to life.
God told me to lie on my side for over a year as a sign.
I saw a vision of God's glory leaving and returning to the temple.

name: Caleb
clues: I was one of twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.
Only I and one other spy said we could take the land.
I trusted God when ten others were afraid.
I waited 45 years for the promise God made to me.
At age 85 I asked Joshua for the hill country as my inheritance.
